responsibility: This target option definition file declares the user-visible C6X command-line options and ties them to backend variables and enums. It defines endianness, simulator, DSBT, long-call, small-data, and -march controls, includes the C6X option header for shared enums, and feeds GCC’s generated option parser so c6x.cc can react to parsed target settings in a structured way.
same_name_distinction: Defines the C6X target option table consumed by GCC’s option generator, mapping flags like `-mbig-endian`, `-msdata=`, `-mdsbt`, `-mlong-calls`, and `-march=` to masks, enums, and backend variables. Unlike `c6x.cc` it does not implement behavior for those options, unlike `c6x.h` it is not the target macro/specification header, and unlike `c6x.md` it is not the RTL instruction-pattern description.
